purpose: Nothing reaches the public site without crossing these gates.

steps.condition: The article file exists and is not empty.
steps.refuses: An empty file, or a title with no body.

steps.condition: Every trade word is decoded where it appears.
steps.refuses: Jargon left naked. The reader should not need a second document.

steps.condition: No publication date is printed in the body.
steps.refuses: A date, which makes a living article look stale in six months.

steps.condition: A reviewer other than the author has signed off.
The owner has seen the rendered page, not the file name.
steps.refuses: A link with no screenshot. Reading is not seeing.
